What is the ratio of the number of students who graduated from Urdu department in the year 2015 to the number of students who graduated from Urdu department in all the years?
solution:
**Given:**

The number of students who graduated from the Urdu department in the year 2015 is 64.

The total number of students who graduated from the Urdu department in all years (2014 to 2018):

 
• 2014: 58
 
• 2015: 64
 
• 2016: 50
 
• 2017: 60
 
• 2018: 55
